answer: A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The vertex counter is kept in terrace and jetty shows each reset. A hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 157 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
